full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a dark-haired woman standing among shadowed figures beside an ornate doorway. Most of the background is nearly black, with faint vertical reflections or interior forms behind the people. Along the right edge, a narrow architectural strip carries repeating circular reliefs that catch pale light. The woman stands just right of center in a light sleeveless dress with a narrow neckline and a small bright necklace. Her softly waved dark hair frames a pale face turned toward the camera; the expression is calm and direct, with dark lips and eyes set against bright skin. A sharp area of light crosses her left shoulder and upper body, while the lower part of the dress disappears abruptly into shadow. On the left, a man in a dark brimmed hat, pale shirt, and dark tie looks downward rather than outward. His hat shades most of his eyes, and his partly illuminated cheek and shirt remain much less distinct than the woman's face. A glass with a slender bright rim stands near his hand in the lower left. At the far right, another hat and head are almost completely swallowed by darkness, leaving a strong black silhouette against the decorated door frame. The people are very close to one another, and the crop cuts across their bodies before any surrounding room can be fully explained. Hard, selective light seems to reach the woman from the front left, shaping her face and shoulder while deep shadows split the garment and obscure both men. The photograph retains visible grain, sharp light-dark boundaries, and a slight softness in dark areas. The overall composition is intimate and dramatic, with one luminous figure held inside a dense arrangement of black silhouettes and narrow architectural detail.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片呈现一名黑发女子，站在华丽门口旁被阴影笼罩的人群中。背景大部分近乎漆黑，人物后方只有微弱的竖向反光或室内形体。右缘一道狭窄的建筑装饰带刻着重复的圆形浮雕，接住浅色光。女子站在中央偏右，穿浅色无袖衣裙，领口狭窄，戴着一条细小发亮的项链。柔和波浪状深发围着她转向镜头的浅色面孔；表情平静而直接，深色唇眼与明亮肤色相对照。一片边缘清晰的光横过她的左肩和上身，衣裙下部则突然消失在阴影里。左侧男子戴深色宽檐帽、穿浅色衬衫和深色领带，目光向下而不是朝外。他的帽子遮住大部分眼睛，半受光的脸颊和衬衫也远不如女子面孔清晰。左下方，一只杯子的细亮杯口靠近他的手。最右缘，另一顶帽子和头部几乎完全被黑暗吞没，只在装饰门框前留下深色剪影。人们互相靠得很近，画面在周围空间尚未完整展开前就裁去了他们的身体。强烈而有选择的光似乎从左前方照到女子，塑造她的脸与肩膀，深影则切断衣裙并掩住两名男子。照片保留可见颗粒、清晰的明暗边界和暗部的轻微柔化。整体构图亲密而富有戏剧性，以一名明亮人物置于密集黑色剪影与狭窄建筑细节之间。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photographic surface concentrates intense light on a small central area and lets much of the surrounding frame sink into dense black. Pale highlights are crisp and selective, while dark forms overlap until some outlines disappear altogether. A narrow strip of repeating relief texture interrupts broad matte shadow, giving the composition a small vertical counterweight. Close cropping and partially visible bodies create a candid, compressed rhythm rather than a formally spaced arrangement. Hard directional light describes rounded volume through abrupt bands of illumination and deep shadow, with little reflected detail in the darkest passages. Fine film grain and slight softness in shadow keep the high contrast tactile. Depth comes from the transition between luminous near surfaces, dim adjacent silhouettes, and a nearly unreadable rear field. The overall effect is intimate, theatrical, and quietly tense.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影表面把强光集中在中央一小片区域，让画幅周围大部分沉入浓黑。浅色高光清晰而有选择，深色形体互相遮叠，部分轮廓完全消失。一道重复浮雕肌理的狭窄条带打断宽阔的哑光阴影，成为构图中小小的竖向平衡。紧贴的裁切和只露出一部分的形体形成抓拍式压缩节奏，而非正式均匀的排列。强烈定向光通过突然出现的亮带与深影描绘圆润体积，最暗区域几乎没有反射细节。细微胶片颗粒和暗部轻柔化保留了高反差的触感。深度来自发亮的近处表面、昏暗的相邻剪影与几乎不可辨认的后方区域之间的过渡。整体效果亲近、富于戏剧性而暗含紧张。
theme_en: A woman illuminated among shadowed figures at a dark doorway
theme_zh: 暗色门口的人群中，一位被光照亮的女子
name: Louis Faurer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
